sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. After a recent loss, Sandbach will be looking to return to winning ways against a struggling Alsager side who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in a match between two mid-table contenders, while in-form Wolverhampton Casuals (19 points, recent run of W-W-W) visit Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points and on a strong run, host Foley Meir. Barnton welcome Shawbury United—a team in freefall with six consecutive losses. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a clash of mid-table sides, while Brereton Social host winless Widnes Town (2 points from 7 games). Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle, Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Eccleshall visit AFC Bridgnorth completes the weekend's fixtures.
